  "pros": [
    "Improved financial reporting and data integrity compared to previous software.",
    "Efficient bank reconciliation and automated transaction categorization.",
    "Cloud-based access facilitates collaboration and remote work."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steeper learning curve and more complex setup than simpler alternatives.",
    "Specific customization options for detailed research project tracking were limited.",
    "Cost felt a bit high considering some advanced features for larger businesses were still lacking."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The QA/QC Field Engineer found Xero to be a significant upgrade from their previous accounting software, offering much-needed functionality for a growing research company. They appreciated the robust reporting and streamlined bank reconciliation processes, which improved data accuracy. However, they noted that while generally user-friendly, it required more effort to configure, and some features for enterprise-level reporting or highly specific project accounting in a research context felt underdeveloped for the cost."
